content.value: On 1st January Mr. Aman started a business with cash Tk 300,000 and furniture worth (35) [CO2] Tk 80,000. Other transactions are as follows:
January1Office rent paid in cash Tk 15,000.
99 4 An advertisement bill received but not yet paid Tk 6,000.
5 Office supplies purchase in cash Tk 4,000.
99 8 Hired an office assistant for the month of salary Tk 14,000.
9 Utility bill received and paid in cash Tk 700.
,9 10 Insurance premium paid in cask Tk 2,000.
99 12 Cash withdrawn from business for owner's personal use Tk 12,000.
ii) Prepare a tabular summary and show the effects on accounting equation.
